source: Base action library adapted from GIW Environmental Solutions' Green Travel Plan template (DateGIWREFAddressGTP2022A.docx).

actions.text: Produce a walking map showing safe and pleasurable walking routes to and from the building with times to local facilities such as shops and bus stops (e.g. Walkscore)
Open up short cuts for pedestrian access across/along the site
Review condition of existing footpaths onsite; provide additional or upgraded footpaths to meet occupant needs
Negotiate with the local council for footpath improvements
Ensure pedestrian safety and access is not compromised during construction
Take part in 'National Walk to Work Day' to encourage residents/staff to walk to work
Run 'Travel Smart Get to Work Days' encouraging walking, cycling and public transport
Provide a map to residents/occupants outlining locations of on-site bicycle parking
Provide sufficient secure bicycle parking to meet peak needs — accessible, well-lit and secure
Provide visitor bicycle parking
Ensure bike parking is clearly visible or well signposted
Review and improve interconnection with existing on-site/adjacent cycle routes
Upgrade or provide new on-site cycle routes
Ensure cycle routes are not compromised during construction
Develop a 'bike buddy' scheme for inexperienced cyclists
Supply a puncture-repair/tool kit, bike pump, spare lock and lights for shared use
Provide a pool bicycle (and e-bike where feasible) for short trips during the day
Arrange servicing/discount incentives with a local bicycle retailer
Establish an internal Bicycle Users Group (BUG)
Participate in annual events such as 'Ride to Work Day'
Provide e-bike/e-scooter charging points at bicycle parking areas
Provide showers and changing rooms sized to peak demand
Provide lockers for a change of clothes, located near changing rooms
Provide a drying room/facility for wet weather gear
Produce a map showing public transport routes to the site
Provide a shuttle bus linking the site to the nearest train station for construction workers and/or building users
Provide train/tram/bus timetables for local services in household or tenant welcome packs
Provide a myki card with pre-loaded 'myki money' in welcome packs for new residents/tenants
Provide an interest-free loan or subsidy toward an annual myki pass
Provide discounted travel cards
Encourage public transport use for business travel
Allocate priority parking spaces for car poolers
Apply for a privately-operated car-share pod on-site or in close proximity
Set up a carpooling database/app for residents or tenants
Identify priority car park users (e.g. people with disabilities, shift workers)
Provide electric vehicle charging points
Provide dedicated car-share spaces
Provide spaces for mopeds/motorbikes
Introduce an exclusion zone restricting parking permits for staff/residents living in close proximity to the site
Minimise/unbundle car parking supply relative to the planning scheme maximum, consistent with council parking-reform policy
Install teleconference facilities to replace some regular in-person meetings
Provide on-site amenities such as a café or crèche to reduce off-site trip generation
Support flexible/remote work arrangements to reduce peak commuter trips
Commit to developing an Operational Green Travel Plan for occupants and staff using the building
Monitor and report — conduct surveys and keep records of uptake of GTP initiatives
Review parking-permit policy for new staff/residents
Offer incentives (e.g. cash-out) for staff/residents who give up a car parking space
Appoint a Green Travel Plan / Sustainable Transport Coordinator responsible for implementation
